1	/**
2	 * Stripe webhook event processor — extracted helper.
3	 *
4	 * Called by:
5	 *   1. app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts — after signature verification
6	 *   2. workers/jobs/webhook-replay.ts   — bypasses sig verification for trusted internal replays
7	 *
8	 * This function is the ONLY source of truth for post-verification Stripe event dispatch.
9	 * Adding a new event type: add a case here only, not in the route.
10	 *
11	 * INVARIANT 7: Dodo (L1) and Stripe (L2) abstractions never share a module.
12	 *
13	 * Design note — no `import type Stripe from 'stripe'`:
14	 * Workers use moduleResolution: Node which resolves stripe to the CJS default export
15	 * (StripeConstructor) where Stripe.Account / Stripe.Event are not accessible. App uses
16	 * moduleResolution: bundler which resolves the ESM default export where they are.
17	 * Solution: structural local interfaces for the shapes we actually need. The Stripe SDK
18	 * types are a superset of these interfaces — both callers satisfy them at runtime.
19	 */
20	
21	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
22	import {
23	  RPC,
24	  type StripeConnectedAccountUpdateFromWebhookArgs,
25	  type StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs,
26	  type StripeDisputeRecordArgs,
27	  type StripeDisputeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs,
28	  type ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus,
29	  type Currency,
30	  type StripeChargeStatus,
31	  type StripeDisputeStatus,
32	  cents,
33	} from '@/lib/payments/contracts'
34	
35	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	// Local structural interfaces — describe exactly the fields this module uses.
37	// The Stripe SDK types are structural supersets of these.
38	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
39	
40	interface StripeAccountShape {
41	  id: string
42	  charges_enabled?: boolean | null
43	  payouts_enabled?: boolean | null
44	  capabilities?: Record<string, string> | null
45	  requirements?: {
46	    disabled_reason?: string | null
47	    current_deadline?: number | null
48	    errors?: unknown[]
49	  } | null
50	  country?: string | null
51	  default_currency?: string | null
52	}
53	
54	interface StripePaymentIntentShape {
55	  id: string
56	  latest_charge?: string | { id: string } | null
57	  metadata?: Record<string, string | undefined> | null
58	  amount?: number                                     // S17
59	  currency?: string | null                            // S17
60	  amount_details?: {                                  // S17
61	    tax?: { amount: number } | null
62	    tax_breakdown?: Array<{
63	      amount: number
64	      jurisdiction?: { country?: string; state?: string | null } | null
65	      tax_rate_details?: { tax_type?: string | null } | null
66	    }> | null
67	  } | null
68	}
69	
70	interface StripeRefundShape {
71	  id: string
72	  amount: number
73	  currency: string
74	  status: 'pending' | 'requires_action' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'canceled'
75	  reason: string | null
76	  metadata: Record<string, string | undefined> | null
77	}
78	
79	interface StripeChargeShape {
80	  id: string
81	  payment_intent?: string | null
82	  amount: number
83	  amount_refunded: number
84	  currency?: string | null
85	  status?: string | null
86	  metadata?: Record<string, string | undefined> | null  // S19
87	  refunds?: { data: StripeRefundShape[] } | null         // S19
88	}
89	
90	interface StripeDisputeShape {
91	  id: string
92	  charge?: string | { id?: string } | null
93	  evidence_details?: { due_by?: number | null } | null
94	  reason?: string | null
95	  status?: string | null
96	  amount: number
97	  currency?: string | null
98	}
99	
100	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
101	// Untyped RPC helpers — Sprint 13: RPCs not yet in generated types.ts.
102	// Run `pnpm db:types` after Dato's migration lands to remove these casts (§S13.3).
103	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
104	
105	type UntypedRpc = (
106	  fn: string,
107	  args: Record<string, unknown>,
108	) => Promise<{ data: unknown; error: { message: string } | null }>
109	
110	type UntypedFrom = (table: string) => {
111	  select: (cols: string) => {
112	    eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
113	      maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: Record<string, string> | null; error: unknown }>
114	    }
115	  }
116	}
117	
118	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
119	// Public interfaces — exported so worker and route handler can use them
120	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
121	
122	/**
123	 * Minimal structural event interface for the processStripeEvent public signature.
124	 *
125	 * Stripe.Event satisfies this structurally. Workers cast `rawPayload as StripeEventLike`.
126	 * Using a structural type avoids the Stripe.Event import incompatibility between
127	 * moduleResolution: bundler (app) and moduleResolution: Node (workers).
128	 */
129	export interface StripeEventLike {
130	  id: string
131	  type: string
132	  data: { object: unknown }
133	}
134	
135	/**
136	 * Minimal Supabase client interface — only the operations this module uses.
137	 * Structural (not nominal) so both @supabase/ssr and @supabase/supabase-js clients satisfy it.
138	 * Both expose `rpc` and `from` as functions with a `.bind` method (Function prototype).
139	 */
140	export interface SupabaseServiceClient {
141	  rpc: { bind(thisArg: unknown): (...args: never[]) => unknown }
142	  from: { bind(thisArg: unknown): (...args: never[]) => unknown }
143	}
144	
145	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
146	// Main dispatch function
147	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
148	
149	/**
150	 * Dispatch a verified Stripe event to the appropriate handler.
151	 *
152	 * @param event   - Verified Stripe event (signature already checked by caller).
153	 * @param supabase - Service-role client. Bypasses RLS. Caller must supply this.
154	 * @throws         - On RPC failure. Caller is responsible for error logging + retry.
155	 */
156	export async function processStripeEvent(
157	  event: StripeEventLike,
158	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
159	): Promise<void> {
160	  logger.info({ type: event.type, eventId: event.id }, 'stripe: processing event')
161	
162	  switch (event.type) {
163	    case 'account.updated':
164	      await handleAccountUpdated(event.data.object as StripeAccountShape, supabase)
165	      break
166	
167	    case 'payment_intent.succeeded':
168	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
169	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
170	        'succeeded',
171	        event.type,
172	        supabase,
173	      )
174	      break
175	
176	    case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
177	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
178	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
179	        'requires_payment_method',
180	        event.type,
181	        supabase,
182	      )
183	      break
184	
185	    case 'payment_intent.canceled':
186	      await handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
187	        event.data.object as StripePaymentIntentShape,
188	        'canceled',
189	        event.type,
190	        supabase,
191	      )
192	      break
193	
194	    case 'charge.refunded': {
195	      await handleChargeRefunded(event.data.object as StripeChargeShape, supabase)
196	      break
197	    }
198	
199	    case 'charge.dispute.created':
200	      await handleDisputeCreated(event.data.object as StripeDisputeShape, supabase)
201	      break
202	
203	    case 'charge.dispute.closed':
204	      await handleDisputeClosed(event.data.object as StripeDisputeShape, supabase)
205	      break
206	
207	    case 'invoice.finalized': {
208	      await handleInvoiceFinalized(event.data.object as StripeInvoiceShape, supabase)
209	      break
210	    }
211	    case 'invoice.payment_succeeded': {
212	      await handleInvoicePaymentSucceeded(event.data.object as StripeInvoiceShape, supabase)
213	      break
214	    }
215	
216	    default:
217	      logger.info({ type: event.type, eventId: event.id }, 'stripe: event recorded, not processed')
218	  }
219	}
220	
221	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
222	// account.updated
223	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
224	
225	async function handleAccountUpdated(
226	  account: StripeAccountShape,
227	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
228	): Promise<void> {
229	  const onboardingStatus = deriveOnboardingStatus(account)
230	  const capabilities = account.capabilities ?? {}
231	  const restrictedReason = account.requirements?.disabled_reason ?? null
232	
233	  const currentDeadline = account.requirements?.current_deadline
234	  const requirementsDueBy = currentDeadline
235	    ? new Date(currentDeadline * 1_000).toISOString()
236	    : null
237	
238	  const args: StripeConnectedAccountUpdateFromWebhookArgs = {
239	    accountId: account.id,
240	    onboardingStatus,
241	    capabilities: {
242	      charges_enabled: account.charges_enabled ?? false,
243	      payouts_enabled: account.payouts_enabled ?? false,
244	      transfers: capabilities['transfers'] === 'active',
245	      tax_reporting_us_1099_nec: capabilities['tax_reporting_us_1099_nec'] === 'active',
246	    },
247	    country: account.country ?? 'US',
248	    defaultCurrency: (account.default_currency ?? 'usd') as Currency,
249	    restrictedReason,
250	    requirementsDueBy,
251	  }
252	
253	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as UntypedRpc
254	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_UPDATE_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
255	    p_account_id: args.accountId,
256	    p_onboarding_status: args.onboardingStatus,
257	    p_capabilities: args.capabilities,
258	    p_country: args.country,
259	    p_default_currency: args.defaultCurrency,
260	    p_restricted_reason: args.restrictedReason,
261	    p_requirements_due_by: args.requirementsDueBy,
262	  })
263	
264	  if (error) {
265	    logger.error({ err: error, accountId: account.id }, 'stripe: account.updated RPC failed')
266	    throw error
267	  }
268	
269	  logger.info({ accountId: account.id, result: data }, 'stripe: account.updated processed')
270	}
271	
272	function deriveOnboardingStatus(account: StripeAccountShape): ConnectedAccountOnboardingStatus {
273	  if (account.charges_enabled && account.payouts_enabled) return 'active'
274	
275	  const disabledReason = account.requirements?.disabled_reason
276	  if (disabledReason) return 'restricted'
277	
278	  const errors = account.requirements?.errors ?? []
279	  if (errors.length > 0) return 'restricted'
280	
281	  return 'pending'
282	}
283	
284	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
285	// payment_intent.succeeded / payment_failed / canceled
286	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
287	
288	async function handlePaymentIntentStatusChange(
289	  pi: StripePaymentIntentShape,
290	  status: StripeChargeStatus,
291	  eventType: string,
292	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
293	): Promise<void> {
294	  const latestCharge = pi.latest_charge
295	  const chargeId =
296	    typeof latestCharge === 'string'
297	      ? latestCharge
298	      : ((latestCharge as { id?: string } | null)?.id ?? null)
299	
300	  const args: StripeChargeUpdateStatusFromWebhookArgs = {
301	    paymentIntentId: pi.id,
302	    status,
303	    chargeId: chargeId ?? null,
304	    transferId: null,
305	    applicationFeeId: null,
306	  }
307	
308	  const rpc = supabase.rpc.bind(supabase) as unknown as UntypedRpc
309	  const { data, error } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
310	    p_payment_intent_id: args.paymentIntentId,
311	    p_status: args.status,
312	    p_charge_id: args.chargeId,
313	    p_transfer_id: args.transferId,
314	    p_application_fee_id: args.applicationFeeId,
315	  })
316	
317	  if (error) {
318	    logger.error({ err: error, piId: pi.id, status }, 'stripe: charge status update RPC failed')
319	    throw error
320	  }
321	
322	  logger.info({ piId: pi.id, status, result: data }, 'stripe: payment_intent status updated')
323	
324	  const depositTxnId = pi.metadata?.inkos_deposit_transaction_id
325	
326	  if (eventType === 'payment_intent.succeeded') {
327	    // SAGA step 2 — confirm deposit
328	    if (depositTxnId && depositTxnId.length > 0) {
329	      const { error: confirmErr } = await rpc(RPC.CONFIRM_DEPOSIT_APPLICATION, {
330	        p_transaction_id: depositTxnId,
331	        p_payment_intent_id: pi.id,
332	      })
333	      if (confirmErr) {
334	        logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, deposit_txn: depositTxnId, err: confirmErr },
335	          'CRITICAL: confirm_deposit_application failed on PI succeeded')
336	        throw confirmErr
337	      }
338	    }
339	
340	    // Write commission_splits row from PI metadata
341	    const studioId = pi.metadata?.inkos_studio_id
342	    const artistId = pi.metadata?.inkos_artist_id
343	    const bookingId = pi.metadata?.inkos_booking_id
344	    const sessionId = pi.metadata?.inkos_session_id
345	    if (studioId && artistId && bookingId) {
346	      // §S13.3 — types.ts regen pending; cast for stripe_charges read
347	      const fromUntyped = supabase.from as unknown as (table: string) => {
348	        select: (cols: string) => {
349	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
350	            single: () => Promise<{ data: Record<string, unknown> | null; error: unknown }>
351	          }
352	        }
353	      }
354	      const { data: chargeData } = await fromUntyped('stripe_charges')
355	        .select('net_artist_cents, application_fee_cents, tip_amount_cents, deposit_drawdown_cents, transfer_id')
356	        .eq('payment_intent_id', pi.id)
357	        .single()
358	
359	      if (chargeData) {
360	        const charge = chargeData as {
361	          net_artist_cents: number
362	          application_fee_cents: number
363	          tip_amount_cents: number
364	          deposit_drawdown_cents: number
365	          transfer_id: string | null
366	        }
367	        const totalArtistShare = charge.net_artist_cents + charge.application_fee_cents
368	        const commissionPct = totalArtistShare > 0
369	          ? Math.round((charge.net_artist_cents / totalArtistShare) * 100)
370	          : 100
371	
372	        const { error: splitErr } = await rpc(RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_RECORD, {
373	          p_studio_id: studioId,
374	          p_booking_id: bookingId,
375	          p_session_id: sessionId ?? null,
376	          p_artist_id: artistId,
377	          p_base_amount_cents: charge.net_artist_cents,
378	          p_commission_pct: commissionPct,
379	          p_tip_amount_cents: charge.tip_amount_cents,
380	          p_applied_from_pool_cents: charge.deposit_drawdown_cents,
381	          p_stripe_transfer_id: charge.transfer_id,
382	          p_kind: 'split',
383	        })
384	        if (splitErr) {
385	          logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, err: splitErr },
386	            'commission_split_record failed on PI succeeded — recoverable via reconciliation cron')
387	          // Don't throw — reconciliation cron will catch this
388	        }
389	      }
390	    }
391	
392	    // === S17 — Tax mirror + per-tax-line attribution ===
393	
394	    const taxTotal = pi.amount_details?.tax?.amount ?? 0
395	    const taxBreakdown = pi.amount_details?.tax_breakdown ?? []
396	
397	    // 1. Update stripe_charges.tax_amount_cents via charge update RPC.
398	    // Track D extended stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook to accept p_tax_amount_cents.
399	    const { error: chargeTaxErr } = await rpc(RPC.STRIPE_CHARGE_UPDATE_STATUS_FROM_WEBHOOK, {
400	      p_payment_intent_id: pi.id,
401	      p_status: 'succeeded',
402	      p_charge_id: typeof pi.latest_charge === 'string'
403	        ? pi.latest_charge
404	        : (pi.latest_charge?.id ?? null),
405	      p_transfer_id: null,
406	      p_application_fee_id: null,
407	      p_tax_amount_cents: taxTotal,
408	    })
409	    if (chargeTaxErr) {
410	      logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, err: chargeTaxErr },
411	        'S17: stripe_charge_update_status_from_webhook (tax pass) failed')
412	      throw chargeTaxErr
413	    }
414	
415	    // 2. Per-tax-line attribution to commission_splits.
416	    if (taxBreakdown.length > 0 && studioId && bookingId) {
417	      // §S13.3 — types.ts regen pending
418	      const fromUntyped2 = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
419	        select: (cols: string) => {
420	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
421	            eq: (col2: string, val2: string) => {
422	              order: (col3: string, opts: { ascending: boolean }) => {
423	                limit: (n: number) => {
424	                  maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: { id: string } | null; error: unknown }>
425	                }
426	              }
427	            }
428	          }
429	        }
430	      }
431	      const { data: parentSplitData } = await fromUntyped2('commission_splits')
432	        .select('id')

434	        .eq('kind', 'split')

436	        .limit(1)
437	        .maybeSingle()
438	
439	      if (parentSplitData) {
440	        const parentSplitId = parentSplitData.id
441	        const eventDate = new Date()
442	        const quarter = Math.floor(eventDate.getMonth() / 3) + 1
443	        const period = `${eventDate.getFullYear()}-Q${quarter}`
444	
445	        // Look up studio's primary location once.
446	        const fromUntypedSelect = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
447	          select: (cols: string) => {

459	          .maybeSingle()
460	
461	        for (const line of taxBreakdown) {

463	          const state = line.jurisdiction?.state ?? null
464	          const jurisdiction = state ? `${country ?? 'US'}-${state}` : (country ?? 'UNKNOWN')
465	          const taxLineId = `${parentSplitId}:${jurisdiction}`
466	
467	          const { error: lineErr } = await rpc(RPC.COMMISSION_SPLIT_TAX_LINE_RECORD, {
468	            p_parent_split_id: parentSplitId,
469	            p_tax_line_id: taxLineId,
470	            p_jurisdiction: jurisdiction,
471	            p_tax_amount_cents: line.amount,
472	          })
473	          if (lineErr) {
474	            logger.error({ pi_id: pi.id, parent_split: parentSplitId, jurisdiction, err: lineErr },
475	              'S17: commission_split_tax_line_record failed — recoverable via reconciliation')
476	          }
477	
478	          if (locationData) {
479	            const { error: accrueErr } = await rpc(RPC.TAX_REMITTANCE_ACCRUE, {
480	              p_studio_id: studioId,
481	              p_location_id: locationData.id,
482	              p_jurisdiction: jurisdiction,

484	              p_amount_collected_cents: line.amount,

489	            }
490	          }
491	        }
492	      } else {
493	        logger.warn({ pi_id: pi.id, booking_id: bookingId },
494	          'S17: parent commission_split not found — tax breakdown not recorded')
495	      }
496	    } else if (taxTotal > 0 && studioId) {
497	      // Single-line fallback — no breakdown but tax was charged.
498	      const fallbackJurisdiction = 'UNKNOWN'
499	      const eventDate = new Date()
500	      const quarter = Math.floor(eventDate.getMonth() / 3) + 1
501	      const period = `${eventDate.getFullYear()}-Q${quarter}`
502	
503	      const fromUntypedSelect2 = supabase.from.bind(supabase) as unknown as (table: string) => {
504	        select: (cols: string) => {
505	          eq: (col: string, val: string) => {
506	            limit: (n: number) => {
507	              maybeSingle: () => Promise<{ data: { id: string } | null; error: unknown }>

509	          }

513	        .select('id')

515	        .limit(1)
516	        .maybeSingle()
517	
518	      if (locationData) {

557	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
558	// charge.refunded
559	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
560	
561	async function handleChargeRefunded(
562	  charge: StripeChargeShape,
563	  supabase: SupabaseServiceClient,
564	): Promise<void> {
565	  const piId = charge.payment_intent
566	  if (!piId) {
567	    logger.warn({ charge_id: charge.id }, 'charge.refunded: missing payment_intent — skipping')
568	    return
569	  }
570	
571	  // Update stripe_charges.status (existing behavior).
572	  const newStatus = charge.amount_refunded === charge.amount ? 'refunded' : 'partially_refunded'
573
